messages.subject: Project Falcon - acquisition facility
messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

Confirming the funding structure for Falcon Bidco: equity subscription of £32.6m from our funds and a £14m senior facility from Sterling. Could you confirm the facility is on track for a 27 February completion? Whitfield Carter (James Osei, copied) will liaise on the security and the funds flow.

Gregory Talbot
Calderstone
